title: Implement positivity-preserving, number/energy-conservative quantum 2-to-2 time evolution for arbitrary chi distribution, then couple finite SM bath
objective: Convert a verified instantaneous full Pauli collision source into a true time-evolving, number-conserving nonlinear χ momentum distribution with explicit finite SM energy transfer. Do not use naive clipped Euler, unverified global charge projection or ad hoc thermal reset. Build a conservative finite-volume spectral discretization and independent continuum reference before BEST integration.
prerequisites: Read AGENTS.md, CONTINUOUS-RESEARCH-SPEC.md, all research-control files and current GitHub/PR Actions; check CI #44935768129
Examine kinetics/relativistic_nonlinear_fermion.py, relativistic_weak_form_2to2.py, JSON numerical cutoff/interpolation negative controls and tests
Reproduce analytic FD stationary vs PCHIP equilibrium false heat; quantify errors before changing discretization
steps: Derive eventwise χ redistribution between initial and final p cells with nonnegative interpolation weights in physical energy or volume ensuring discrete N and E moment and Pauli 0..1; electron receives minus exact χ energy
Choose finite-volume q^3 cell measures and collision quadrature consistent with BEST log-Simpson or an explicitly independent continuum reference; avoid hidden grid-weight mismatch like prior BGK bug

Construct a substep integrator with rates and adaptive dt that guarantees 0<=fχ<=1 and number N in the absence of true number-changing processes; test entropy production in a finite bath with heat transfer QSM=-Qchi
Verify thermal FD fixed point at common T without allowing PCHIP tail artifact or strong/weak mismatch to dominate; include exact analytic FD, perturbed FD, and truncation negative control
Run joint convergence for n_q, p/k cutoffs, angular quadrature, time dt and bosonic 1↔2 stiffness; quantify leakage, SM heat feedback and detailed balance

Only then decide whether to integrate this kernel into pinned independent BEST 1↔2+FRW in a fully physical portal model; separately require gauge/UV-complete lepton channels and realistic SM gstar/thermal masses
At each completed verified stage append evidence and negative findings, update checkpoints, commit+push with no force, immediately start next stage in active run
acceptance: Independent unprojected Nχ conservation and Qdark+QSM with physically correct discrete quadrature
Pauli bounds maintained in true integrator without clipping and without self-bath thermal resets
Thermal common-T stationary test and nonthermal relaxation with positive entropy on converged phase-space/time meshes
Reproduction compared to independent weak 5D reference, explicit finite-q tail and interpolation error below physics signal
No gamma_el, 86-eV dark matter, BEC or CLASS claims without further physical validation
fallback: If finite-volume conservative interpolation impossible cheaply, derive exact pairwise energy-bin reaction network with provable invariants on a restricted kernel
If electrons can’t be coupled dynamically, record external-reservoir approximation honestly and do not claim full SM entropy conservation
If CI fails, repair before further scientific claims
deliverables: quantum conservative finite-volume collision solver and tests
compact convergence JSON and updated scientific report
scope: Public repo, draft PR, no merge/force push; no user PC or Computer Use without separate approval.
